limitations: One month of 2026-27 (176 games with outcomes); TEST is 88 games in two cohorts of about a week. A validated row here means the contract rule passed on this window, not that the gain will persist.

History components are tested against a reproduction of the rate rung given ACTUAL minutes, not against the production LightGBM stack, which has no archived forecasts before 2026-10-19. Only one tuning season and one test season are used.
The blend weight on the independent rate reached the upper edge of its pre-set grid (0.5) for ['points', 'assists', 'threes']; the grid was not widened after seeing this.
Teammate-out usage was tested with retrospective absences (who actually sat), an upper bound on a T-60 report; it still failed to replicate and is not in the challenger.

Restored boards exist for 48 of 56 games after 2026-11-06; the rest had no capture within 30 minutes before T-60. 642 restored player tickers carry a player code never seen on projection-data and are not scored.
Team-points and total rows are inconclusive: about 10 points of irreducible error per team-game against corrections of 1 to 3 points.

Sign correction to the alpha-nba-avail-0.2 write-up: its bias fields are actual minus forecast, so -2.40 / -4.80 mean the frozen model OVER-forecasts team points by 2.40 and game totals by 4.80; the 0.2 limitation text and ops-doc sentence say 'under-forecast'. The committed 0.2 numbers are unchanged.

Spread and total probabilities use the same normal approximation with the archived rho as alpha-nba-avail-0.2; a common shift of both teams leaves spreads unchanged, so spread rows move only through the player-sum blend.
2026-27 box history is read from the capture-worker archive as of its pinned commit; a strictly-earlier-date rule is assumed to be available at T-60 (the production model makes the same assumption).
No new external data was collected. No fees, no execution, no profitability claim.

verdict.reason: 5 of 7 headline rows validated against the frozen production forecasts (player distributions); team points and totals are inconclusive; the challenger is still not better than the Kalshi T-60 mid on any family and significantly worse on ['player_points']
verdict.rule: contract.verdict_from on every row: validated = 95% game-clustered bootstrap CI below zero, Holm p < 0.05, same sign in both chronological cohorts. Overall is VALIDATED_IMPROVEMENT only if every headline row is validated AND the challenger is not significantly worse than the Kalshi T-60 mid on any family.
